stories.summary: Sanjeev Kapoor's Chinese bread pakodas are the perfect snack to indulge in when craving something old and new at the same time. Everyone loves a good bread pakoda. stories.title: Kozhikode Corporation health wing finds violations at hotels, eateries
stories.summary: The Health wing of the Kozhikode Corporation continued its inspections at hotels, eateries, and lodges across the city on Saturday (November 21) to ensure food safety, hygiene, waste management, and public health standards. Officials said that notices had been issued to establishments where violations were detected during the inspections, and that further action had been initiated against them.

stories.title: Further walkout planned by NI doctors as strike ends
stories.summary: A 24-hour strike by resident doctors in Northern Ireland held as part of an ongoing dispute over pay has ended, but fresh action will begin on Monday. Consultants and specialist doctors will begin a separate 24-hour strike following the weekend, as part of the same dispute. 5% pay rise and wants to restore the value of doctors' pay to 2008 levels.

stories.title: Faculty, students of medical colleges take out rally for World Antimicrobial Awareness Week
stories.summary: Faculty and students from seven medical colleges in Puducherry took out a rally to observe World Antimicrobial Awareness Week. The programme was held under the aegis of the Indian Association of Medical Microbiologists, Puducherry Chapter. The rally was taken out to spread the message about the importance of responsible use of antibiotics and other antimicrobial agents.

stories.title: Free health check-up camp in Tenkasi
stories.summary: Aarthi Scans and Labs is organising a free health check-up camp on Sunday (November 22) at Housing Board Park in the first ward here. An official statement said the free health check-up camp was being organised to encourage preventive healthcare and promote awareness about common health conditions. As part of the initiative, visitors can avail themselves of free blood sugar, cholesterol and blood pressure (BP) screenings.

stories.title: Oily Skin? Here's How To Control Excess Sebum Without Drying Out Your Skin
stories.summary: When your face feels excessively oily throughout the day, the immediate instinct is to wash it away with the strongest cleanser you can find. However, stripping away every bit of moisture in turn triggers a panic mode in the sebaceous glands (oil glands attached to your hair follicles), which eventually causes them to produce even more oil to compensate for the lost moisture.

stories.title: Keralam girl develops kidney ailment after ‘using’ fairness cream promoted on social media
stories.summary: A 17-year-old girl in Keralam has developed a serious kidney ailment allegedly after using a fairness cream purchased online following its promotion by social media influencers, doctors treating her said on Saturday (November 21, 2026). According to doctors at Aster MIMS Mother Hospital in Malappuram, the girl ordered the cream after watching promotional videos by Instagram influencers who claimed it could remove pimples, dark spots and pigmentation.

stories.title: Chennai hospital observes newborn and prematurity week
stories.summary: Kanchi Kamakoti CHILDS Trust Hospital (KKCTH) observed the “National Newborn Week” and World Prematurity Week from November 15 to 21. According to a press release, this year’s theme - “Small babies! Big Potential! Invest in follow up care”, reinforces the importance of saving preterm neonates with intact survival.

stories.title: Pregnancy anxiety in the age of AI: Every symptom is a search, and every search a potential scare
stories.summary: At 2 am, when the baby hasn’t kicked as frequently as it did the previous evening, or when a headache refuses to go away, the temptation to seek an immediate answer is irresistible — and worse, handy. stories.title: Study highlights need for trauma-informed, community-based mental health support for refugees in India
stories.summary: The study calls for mental health support rooted in refugee communities, with trained local workers and refugee leaders playing a central role in shaping care that responds to their lived realities, including legal uncertainty, social exclusion and difficult living conditions

stories.title: Doctor shares 5 early warning signs of childhood diabetes that parents should not ignore: Excessive thirst to blurred vision
stories.summary: While diabetes is commonly associated with adults, children can suffer from the disease as well and need immediate medical attention when showing symptoms. Diabetes is one of the most common chronic diseases across the globe and is generally associated with adults. However, children are also being diagnosed with the disease at present, creating growing concern among parents.

stories.title: India vs New Zealand 1st Test Day 4: India declare at 720/9, highest team total in New Zealand
stories.summary: India erased several individual and team records before declaring at 720 for nine, giving itself four-and-a-half sessions to bowl New Zealand out in pursuit of a rare Test win in the country. But it was the first over of the second hour that put the host further on the back foot.

stories.title: Rishabh Pant becomes first Asian wicketkeeper to score century in all SENA countries
stories.summary: India's Rishabh Pant scripted history on Sunday with his latest century in the Wellington Test against New Zealand. After bringing up his ninth Test ton off just 135 deliveries on Day 4 of the first Test at the Basin Reserve, Pant became the first Asian wicketkeeper to score a century in all SENA (South Africa, England, New Zealand and Australia) countries.

stories.title: Sandpapergate scandal: Lehmann denies knowledge of sandpaper plot, says scandal took him to ‘dark place’
stories.summary: Former Australian head coach Darren Lehmann has once again denied knowing about his players' plan to use sandpaper on the ball during the infamous Cape Town Test in 2018, saying he has no recollection of being present when the plot was discussed. stories.title: IND vs NZ 1st Test: Bossing the Basin! KL Rahul's 13th Test ton, Shubman Gill's 98 put India in command
stories.summary: By stumps on Day 3, India, resuming at 159-1, had surged to 486-4 — a lead of 118 — with Rishabh Pant unbeaten on 55. If Rahul’s 136 off 296 balls, with nine fours and two sixes, laid the foundation, Gill’s 98 off 146 balls, with nine fours and two sixes, provided the impetus.

stories.title: Alcaraz to face Zverev in ATP Finals title decider
stories.summary: Carlos Alcaraz will face world number one Alexander Zverev for the ATP Finals title after completing a superb comeback victory against Ben Shelton. stories.summary: Rahul's 136 made him the first Indian opener to score Test hundreds in all four SENA countries. stories.title: Pat Cummins wins Cricket Australia's ‘unanimous support’ to remain Test captain
stories.summary: Cricket Australia threw its "unanimous support" behind Pat Cummins to remain Test captain on Saturday (November 21, 2026), rejecting any suggestion his integrity had been compromised by the lingering "Sandpapergate" scandal. stories.title: Satwik-Chirag pair exits Hong Kong Open; Lakshya also bows out
stories.summary: India's challenge ended at the Hong Kong Open Super 500 badminton tournament after the men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, and Lakshya Sen lost their respective semifinals on Saturday (November 21, 2026). stories.title: EPFO’s Systematic Withdrawal Plan: What is the waiting period for final PF withdrawal if unemployed? Explained here

stories.title: Unprecedented! Gill's India achieve a first in 149-year history of Test cricket

stories.title: Messi Bouli on target as Punjab FC draw 1-1 against Chennaiyin FC
stories.summary: Punjab FC held Chennaiyin FC to a 1-1 draw in the Indian Super League (ISL) at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, in Chennai, on Saturday. Chennaiyin went ahead through a Nikhil Prabhu own goal (13’) before Raphael Messi Bouli pulled Punjab level just before half-time.

stories.summary: The All India Football Federation (AIFF) elections are on December 20 but three unrelated developments over the past two days indicate that things are heating up. stories.title: Australia's Chaudhary downs England in tetchy first T20
stories.summary: Unlikely Australia international Nikhil Chaudhary rattled England and was the match-winner in a tense and tetchy final-over victory in the first T20 international in Melbourne. stories.summary: The Indian blind cricket team boycotted the presentation ceremony of the men's Asia Cup in Dhaka on Friday after Pakistan were declared champions despite the final being washed out without a ball being bowled. stories.title: India A Eye Another Dominant Show Against Pakistan A In Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026

stories.title: NZ vs IND: Rishabh Pant enters record books with historic Test hundred in New Zealand

stories.summary: Rishabh Pant has endured a turbulent year, losing his Test vice-captaincy and his place in the ODIs, but his response remains unmistakably his own. stories.summary: Ever wondered why the calf muscles are commonly nicknamed as the human body’s ‘second heart’? The answer is purely technical. The muscles play a pivotal role in this.
